outline_iou.note: Asserted 1.0 for puppets and every stage layer (backdrop key blocks as laid, crowd, bus shadow, bus body, bus front, bell tassel, both wheels): Δ treatment changes fill only.

seed_differences.note: Both seeds happen to vacate seat A; the vacate draw is still seeded (rng(seed,'vacate')).

replay.method: sha1 of RGB bytes; second render in a fresh python -I process

audio_pcm.method: kit.Mix rebuilt in-process from the film module's sound function, mastered exactly as Film.render does, s16 PCM sliced per 7.0 s window (6 clip windows + the S9 grid window), hashed BEFORE the AAC encode

aac_decoded.note: the mp4's AAC 96 kb/s track is lossy and its 1024-sample frames do not align with the 7.0 s windows, so decoded windows are NOT bit-identical; identity is claimed for the PCM before encoding only

observed: These results describe six inspected samples (3 conditions x seeds 0417, 0418) of one engine: 'kit.py procedural animatic' = stage.py + rig.py at generator_rev a81c80d6f3e3.
Seeds are repeatable in this engine: frames 0, 29, 132 of all six samples re-render byte-identically in a fresh process (True).

In this engine the seed governs only unprotected elements (runner count 7 vs 8, positions, phases, idle holds, print grain); protected masks are identical across seeds on all 168 frames, side and plan (True).
The treatment field changed fill only (puppet outline IoU min 1.0000).
The camera field changed projection and lost anchors ['A-neck', 'A4c', 'A6w']; partially kept ['A-hat', 'A0', 'A1', 'A5', 'A5d', 'A7', 'A8'].
not_claimed: Nothing here is evidence about text-to-video or text-to-image generators in general, or about how Martino's own generator handled seeds, fixed actions or prompt deltas; the film is a stand-in engine whose isolation of seed streams is built in by design (P4).
An intended-effect rate of n of 2 is a count over two inspected samples, not an estimate of a probability.
The counterexample shows this harness detects one class of drift (projector drawing from a shared stream); it does not prove absence of other drift classes.
